events.title: 30th Annual Edgefest: Kerrytown Concert House
events.summary: One of the world’s 50 top jazz/avant music festivals, according to DownBeat, this annual event includes multiple shows over 4 days. Tonight's lineup features Andrew Bishop, William Hooker Quartet, New Origins Trio, Stein/Smith/Shead Trio, and Fay Victor’s Herbie Nichols SUNG.
events.registration: Tickets $20 per show (students, age 18 & under, $10) in advance at kerrytownconcerthouse.com & (if available) at the door. $70 day passes (Saturday, $100) and 240–390 full festival passes in advance only online & by phone. (734) 769–2999.

legacySeriesKeys: theatre l: my daddy is haunted|planet ant theatre
events.title: Theatre L: My Daddy is Haunted
events.summary: Hammer Horror meets National Lampoons Vacation in the original horror comedy, My Daddy is Haunted! 164 years ago, Sterling Mandrake was accused of heresy and burned alive by a righteous nun. Since then, his castle lay dormant, perched upon a crumbling mountain. That is until the Maplesquatch family arrives for a vacation they’ll never forget! The fun soon turns to terror as something starts to happen to dear old dad. Is that creepy painting alive? What’s with all the bugs? Is their daddy haunted? Come find out for yourself. If you dare! Special Halloween show with costume karaoke after party!
